Hi Elena / Adeel —

Thanks again for the discovery time earlier today — really helpful to understand FinLytics' ingestion patterns and your latency targets. Per our conversation, the next logical step is a focused workshop/demo where we: 1) validate a short end-to-end integration with your sample dataset, 2) walk platform engineers through runtime configuration, and 3) confirm evidence owners for the SOC/evidence packet.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tuesday Mar 28, 9:30–11:00
- Wednesday Mar 29, 13:00–14:30
- Thursday Mar 30, 10:00–11:30

Please pick any slot that works. If none of the above fit, tell me a couple of alternative 90-minute blocks next week and we’ll adjust.

Who we should include from your side: platform engineer (SSO/stack access), security (for evidence owners), and procurement (for contract path). I’ll loop in our Platform lead (Karthik) and Security point (Olga) on the follow-up so we can surface any pre-work.

I’ve attached a short agenda and a checklist of the evidence we typically gather — nothing you have to complete before the call, but it helps speed things up if folks can surface any outstanding compliance items.

Next steps: confirm a slot and share the preferred attendee list (names + emails).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
